$schema: LLM pricing comparison data — Tab 1 (Pricing Comparison) and Tab 2 (Cost Calculator)
notes: Prices pulled directly from each provider's official pricing page on 2026-09-15. LLM pricing changes frequently — re-check the source URLs periodically rather than treating this as permanent. All providers below price in tokens; none required credit/compute-unit normalization at the time of writing.

models.notes: Launched 2026-09-03, priced ~2.5x GPT-5.6 Sol. openai.com/api/pricing/ was unreachable while compiling this entry (403), so figures are cross-checked across OpenAI's own launch post (openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/) and multiple third-party trackers (Yotta Labs, Layer3 Labs, AiCybr) that agree on these numbers. Rate shown is for prompts <=272,000 tokens; above that threshold pricing rises to $20 input / $75 output / $2 cached (2x input & cache, 1.5x output). Cache writes cost extra at $12.50/MTok. Fast mode (up to 2x speed) is 2x standard rates; Batch/Flex processing is 50% of standard.

Full 1M token context included at standard pricing. Cached input shown is the cache-read (hit) rate — unusually 0.025x base input for this model/Mythos 5.1 (vs. 0.1x for other Claude models). Writing to cache costs extra: 1.25x base input for a 5-min TTL cache ($12.50/MTok) or 2x for a 1-hour TTL ($20/MTok).

Cached input shown is the cache-read (hit) rate (0.1x base input, standard across Claude models except Fable/Mythos 5.1). Writing to cache costs extra: 1.25x base input for a 5-min TTL ($6.25/MTok) or 2x for a 1-hour TTL ($10/MTok).
Cached input shown is the cache-read (hit) rate (0.1x base input). Writing to cache costs extra: 1.25x base input for a 5-min TTL ($2.50/MTok) or 2x for a 1-hour TTL ($4/MTok).
Cached input shown is the cache-read (hit) rate (0.1x base input). Writing to cache costs extra: 1.25x base input for a 5-min TTL ($1.25/MTok) or 2x for a 1-hour TTL ($2/MTok).

Tiered pricing: rates shown are for prompts <=200k tokens. Above 200k tokens: $4.00 input / $18.00 output / $0.40 cached. Batch API gets 50% off; Priority tier is a 1.8x multiplier. Cached-content storage is billed separately at $4.50 per million tokens per hour.

Promotional rate through Dec 31, 2026; rises to $1.50 input / $7.50 output / $0.15 cached after. Batch API gets 50% off. 64k max output tokens. Cached-content storage is billed separately at $0.50 per million tokens per hour (rising to $1.00 in 2027).

Batch API gets 50% off. 64k max output tokens. Context/prompt caching is not offered for this model in the Standard tier, unlike the rest of the Gemini lineup — leave cached input blank rather than guessing.
